items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Dudley Brooks was playing piano, and who was bass?

ctx.x: So we used to rehearse at the Union ... no, this wasn't the Union. It was right across from Jefferson High School when Covan had his dancing school? Jefferson High

School, on 39th or 38th Street. This is where we used to rehearse with Eddie Barefield, okay. And Paul Howard was in the band. Jack McBea was in the band ... what was that guy's name? Dudley Brooks was playing piano, and who was bass? Gee ...
